passages.provision_quote: The Department shall review each submission made by a parent, together with the basis for the parent's findings and, If the department agrees with the parent's findings, the department shall add the book to the list described in subsection A of this section.
passages.note: Single-subject state challenge-process bill: a parent's challenge leads to removal statewide after a review finding by the department of education, a state agency rather than a committee of educators and parents.

rows.reasoning: Shamp voted Y on SB 1700 (2023). Under the bill, a parent's challenge leads to statewide removal once the department of education "agrees with the parent's findings". That meets the review-finding clause of "Remove a challenged book only if a review committee of educators and parents finds it unsuitable". The reviewer, though, is a state agency rather than "a review committee of educators and parents", and the bill does not pull books while they are under review (rung 4). Per the annex, a review by a different body meets only [a], so the row is BLANK compound-partial on the removal side.
